decisive_items: monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement was demonstrated
CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
response.rationale: The presence of monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, abnormal CD4 to CD8 ratio, and atypical lymphocytes more strongly supports the diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma than Mycosis fungoides or Follicular mucinosis.

rejected.why: less specific support for Mycosis fungoides
Follicular mucinosis is less likely given the presence of monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement and atypical lymphocytes
